At at https://adam.math.hhu.de/ that is. Posteditor of my-glossary-based ChatGPT translations, to be precise. With a good help of Marcus Zibrowius, https://www.math.uni-duesseldorf.de/~zibrowius/index_EN.html. 2 games so far, Robo/Scribble and NNG4. Eager to do more. Eager to do all of them.

Here to reach out to/liaise with lean game server authors. Usually start with English copy editing. Now on Intro to Logic, Reintro to Proofs, Number Theory games.

Open to whatever lean community can offer. Interested in lowering the barrier of entry, esp for for C-style language programmers.

BG: Graduated as syseng from https://bmstu.ru/ when it was free as in beer. rns @ proz. rnsatg, formerly rns @ github.
